title: Declaration Generator
description: Generate a TypeScript type definition, utility function, or constant in src/lib/{types,utils,constants}/ with export configuration.

name.description: Name of the declaration. Naming convention follows the chosen kind (e.g. PascalCase for a type, camelCase for a utility, UPPER_SNAKE_CASE for a constant).
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for this declaration?

kind.description: What kind of declaration to generate

x-prompt.message: What kind of declaration would you like to generate?

package.description: Subdirectory within src/ where the declaration is created (default: 'lib')

projectName.description: Target project name where the declaration will be generated. Auto-creates feature if not found.

directory.description: Override the entire directory path for declaration creation

file.description: Optional: Create or append the declaration to an existing file instead of creating a separate file

skipFormat.description: Skip prettier code formatting (used internally for chained generators)

export.description: Export the generated declaration from project root src/index.ts (default: true)
